title: Procedural Fairness in Multi-Agent Bandits
reasoning: The paper defines and evaluates fairness objectives in multi-agent systems based on normative ethical frameworks, including Rawlsian procedural justice, Scanlon's contractualism, and utilitarianism. It specifically benchmarks these different moral/ethical philosophies (e.g., 'equal voice' vs. 'aggregate welfare') against each other to analyze their inherent tradeoffs and legitimacy.
